title: Italian Crumble Peppers
description: A flavorful and crunchy vegetarian side dish that brings together the sweetness of peppers with the savory taste of Italian seasonings.
instructions: Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds.
Place the peppers on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with a little bit of olive oil and sprinkle with Italian seasoning, pepper, and crumble.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the peppers are tender and the topping is golden brown.
Serve hot as a side dish or add to salads or sandwiches.
